name: Differentiable Depth Rendering
aliases: Differentiable Depth Rendering via Implicit Function Theorem
Differentiable Depth via Implicit Function Theorem (IFT) Surrogate
definition: PyTorch integration that provides exact gradients for depth rendering using the Implicit Function Theorem (IFT). This avoids differentiating through the bisection algorithm itself.
summary: Differentiable Depth Rendering computes exact depth gradients via the Implicit Function Theorem, avoiding memory issues from backpropagating through iterative solvers.
